eval: (async () => { const g = game, S = g.sounds, A = g.audio; const V = (x, y, z) => new g.player.position.constructor(x, y, z); const out = {}; const run = async (name, secs, fn) => { const r = await A.debugRender(secs, fn); out[name] = { pico: +r.peak.toFixed(3), rms: +r.rms.toFixed(4), invalido: r.invalid }; }; await run('disparo', 3, a => S.playGunshot(a)); await run('recarga', 3, a => S.playReload(a, 2.6)); await run('ferrolho', 1, a => { S.playBoltOpen(a); S.playBoltClose(a, 0.5); }); await run('impacto pássaro 30 m', 1, a => S.playBirdHit(a, 30, V(30, 0, 0))); await run('impacto tronco 20 m', 1, a => S.playImpact(a, 20, 'trunk', V(20, 0, 0))); for (const id of Object.keys(S.SONGS)) { await run('canto ' + id + ' 15 m', 5, a => S.SONGS[id](a, a.spatial(V(15, 3, 0), 'birds', 5), false)); await run('alarme ' + id, 3, a => S.SONGS[id](a, a.spatial(V(15, 3, 0), 'birds', 5), true)); } await run('canto sabia 80 m', 5, a => S.SONGS.sabia(a, a.spatial(V(80, 3, 0), 'birds', 8), false)); await run('asas', 1.5, a => S.wingFlutter(a, a.spatial(V(5, 0, 0), 'birds', 2), 12)); await run('baque do corpo', 1, a => S.corpseThud(a, a.spatial(V(10, 0, 0), 'birds', 3))); for (const an of S.ANIMALS) await run('animal ' + an.name, 5, a => an.play(a, a.spatial(V(80, 5, 0), 'ambience', an.ref))); await run('grilo', 1, a => S.cricketChirp(a, a.spatial(V(10, 0, 0), 'ambience', 3), 4600)); await run('passo andando (mata)', 1, a => g.footsteps.play(0.3, 0.9, false)); await run('passo correndo (clareira)', 1, a => g.footsteps.play(0.55, 0.1, false)); await run('aterrissagem', 1, a => g.footsteps.play(0.8, 0.5, true)); return out; })()
label: render offline de cada som

eval: (async () => { const A = game.audio; let peak = 0, rms = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { const l = A.level(); peak = Math.max(peak, l.peak); rms = Math.max(rms, l.rms); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100)); } return { pronto: A.ready, pico: +peak.toFixed(4), rms: +rms.toFixed(4) }; })()
label: nível do ambiente ao vivo (vento, folhas, grilos)

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, inp = g.input; const s0 = g.footsteps.steps; inp.down.add('KeyW'); for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) { p.update(1 / 30); g.footsteps.update(1 / 30, p); } inp.down.clear(); const andando = g.footsteps.steps - s0; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { p.update(1 / 30); g.footsteps.update(1 / 30, p); } const s1 = g.footsteps.steps; inp.down.add('KeyW'); inp.down.add('ShiftLeft'); for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) { p.update(1 / 30); g.footsteps.update(1 / 30, p); } inp.down.clear(); const correndo = g.footsteps.steps - s1; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { p.update(1 / 30); g.footsteps.update(1 / 30, p); } const s2 = g.footsteps.steps; inp.pressed.add('Space'); for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { p.update(1 / 30); g.footsteps.update(1 / 30, p); inp.endFrame(); } return { passosAndando3s: andando, passosCorrendo3s: correndo, puloEAterrissagem: g.footsteps.steps - s2 }; })()
label: passos simulados

eval: (() => { const g = game, B = g.birds, cam = g.engine.camera; for (let i = 0; i < 600; i++) { B.update(1 / 30); g.voices.update(1 / 30, B.active, cam.position); g.ambience.update(1 / 30, g.player, cam.position); } B.scare(g.player.position, 80); for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) { B.update(1 / 30); g.voices.update(1 / 30, B.active, cam.position); } return { vozes: g.voices.stats, animais: g.ambience.animalsPlayed, passaros: B.living }; })()
